---
title: "Specs Comparison Tool"
format: html
---

::: {.callout-tip title="How to search for a specific model and size!"}
1. Use the dropdown menu in a column header to search for a specific bike model and size.
2. Simply start typing the model name and the menu list moves to what you have searched
:::

```{r setup-bike-comparison-tool}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: true

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      knitr.kable.NA = '')
source_path <- here::here("bike_geometry_project.R")
source(source_path)

```

```{r no-image}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false
#| results: asis

specs_cols <- c("kmeans_style", "material", "fork", "handlebar", "stack", "reach", "head_tube_angle", "seat_tube_angle","chainstay_length", "front_center", "bottom_bracket_drop", "trail", "trail_45", "udh", "tire_width_max_700c", "tire_width_max_650b", "fork_class", "axle_spacing", "stealth_dropper", "seatpost_diameter", "max_chainring_1x", "dropout", "internal_storage", "base_build_usd", "frameset_usd")
keep_cols <- c("model_size", specs_cols)
specs_wide <- geobike[, .SD, .SDcols = keep_cols]
setnames(specs_wide, 
         old = c("model_size", "kmeans_style", "fork_class"),
         new = c("model", "style", "suspension_correction"))
specs_wide[, front_center := round(front_center, 0)]
specs_wide[, trail := round(trail, 0)]
specs_wide[, trail_45 := round(trail_45, 0)]
specs_wide[, frameset_usd := ifelse(is.na(frameset_usd), frameset_usd, paste0("$", frameset_usd))]
specs_wide[, base_build_usd := ifelse(is.na(base_build_usd), base_build_usd, paste0("$", base_build_usd))]

# specs_wide[!is.na(frameset_usd), frameset_usd := paste0("$", frameset_usd)]
# specs_wide[!is.na(base_build_usd), base_build_usd := paste0("$", base_build_usd)]

specs_cols[1] <- "style"
specs_cols[which(specs_cols == "fork_class")] <- "suspension_correction"

dt <- melt(specs_wide,
              id.vars = "model",
              measure.vars = specs_cols,
              variable.name = "spec",
              value.name = "value")

# Pretty spec names
# Pretty spec names
dt[, spec_pretty := str_replace_all(spec, "_", " ")]
dt[, spec_pretty := str_to_title(spec_pretty)]
dt[, spec_pretty := str_replace(spec_pretty, "Udh", "UDH")]
dt[, spec_pretty := str_replace(spec_pretty, "Usd", "USD")]

# Number of visible comparison columns
ncols <- 4
models <- unique(dt$model)
defaults <- models[seq_len(ncols)]

# JSON data for client-side lookup
json_data <- jsonlite::toJSON(dt, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Header select dropdown
header_select <- function(i) {
  opts <- lapply(models, function(m) {
    if (i <= length(defaults) && identical(m, defaults[i])) {
      tags$option(value = m, selected = "selected", m)
    } else {
      tags$option(value = m, m)
    }
  })
  tags$select(
    class = "form-select form-select-sm searchable",
    style = "width:220px; margin:auto;",
    onchange = sprintf("swapColumn(this, %d)", i),
    `data-col-index` = i,
    opts
  )
}

# Build table
tbl <- tags$table(
  class = "table table-striped table-hover align-middle",
  style = "width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;",
  tags$thead(
    tags$tr(
      tags$th("Spec", style="position: sticky; top: 0; background:#f8f9fa; z-index: 2;"),
      lapply(seq_len(ncols), function(i) tags$th(header_select(i), style="position: sticky; top: 0; background:#f8f9fa; z-index: 2;"))
    )
  ),
  tags$tbody(
    lapply(unique(dt$spec), function(s) {
      pretty_name <- dt[spec==s, spec_pretty][1]
      tags$tr(
        tags$td(pretty_name, `data-spec` = s),
        lapply(seq_len(ncols), function(c) {
          default_model <- if (c <= length(defaults)) defaults[c] else defaults[1]
          val <- dt[spec==s & model==default_model, value]
          if (is.na(val) || identical(val, "NA")) val <- ""
          tags$td(
            `data-spec`  = s,
            `data-col`   = c,
            `data-model` = default_model,
            val
          )
        })
      )
    })
  )
)

# JS: swap columns
js_lookup <- tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
var specsData = %s;
function swapColumn(selectElem, colIndex) {
  var model = selectElem.value;
  var table = selectElem.closest('table');
  var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var spec = row.querySelector('td[data-spec]').getAttribute('data-spec');
    var item = specsData.find(function(d){ return d.spec===spec && d.model===model; });
    if(item){
      var cell = row.querySelector('td[data-col=\"' + colIndex + '\"]');
      if(cell){
        cell.textContent = (item.value === null || item.value === 'NA') ? '' : item.value;
        cell.setAttribute('data-model', model);
      }
    } else {
      var cell = row.querySelector('td[data-col=\"' + colIndex + '\"]');
      if(cell) cell.textContent = '';
    }
  });
}
", json_data)))

# Choices.js assets + initialize searchable selects + scroll to selected
choices_assets <- tagList(
# Replace your Choices.js initialization JavaScript with this:

tags$script(HTML("
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var selects = document.querySelectorAll('select.searchable');
  selects.forEach(function(sel) {
    var colIndex = parseInt(sel.getAttribute('data-col-index'), 10);

    // Initialize Choices
    var choicesInstance = new Choices(sel, {
      searchEnabled: true,
      shouldSort: true,
      itemSelectText: '',
      placeholderValue: 'Select model...'
    });

    // Force scroll styles after Choices.js initialization
    setTimeout(function() {
      var dropdown = sel.parentNode.querySelector('.choices__list--dropdown');
      if (dropdown) {
        dropdown.style.maxHeight = '300px';
        dropdown.style.overflowY = 'auto';
        dropdown.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
        
        // Force scrollbar to be visible
        dropdown.style.scrollbarWidth = 'thin'; // Firefox
        dropdown.style.setProperty('scrollbar-width', 'thin', 'important'); // Firefox
        
        // Webkit scrollbar styles
        var style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = `
          .choices__list--dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 12px !important;
          }
          .choices__list--dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #f1f1f1 !important;
          }
          .choices__list--dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #888 !important;
            border-radius: 6px !important;
          }
          .choices__list--dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #555 !important;
          }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
      }
    }, 100);

    // Set title attribute for hover tooltip and ensure scroll on dropdown open
    sel.addEventListener('showDropdown', function() {
      setTimeout(function() {
        var dropdown = sel.parentNode.querySelector('.choices__list--dropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
          // Force scroll styles again when dropdown opens
          dropdown.style.maxHeight = '300px';
          dropdown.style.overflowY = 'auto';
          dropdown.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
          
          // Add titles for tooltips
          var dropdownItems = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.choices__item');
          dropdownItems.forEach(function(item){
            item.setAttribute('title', item.textContent);
          });

          // Scroll to selected item
          var selectedValue = choicesInstance.getValue(true);
          var highlighted = dropdown.querySelector('.choices__item[data-value=\"' + selectedValue + '\"]');
          if (highlighted) {
            highlighted.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
          }
        }
      }, 50);
    });

    // Column swap functionality
    sel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      swapColumn(sel, colIndex);
    });
  });
});
"))
)

# CSS: sticky header, scrollable dropdown, ellipsis, tooltip
# Replace your CSS with this simplified version:

css <- tags$style(HTML("
.table-striped tbody tr:nth-of-type(odd) {background-color: #f9f9f9;}
.table-hover tbody tr:hover {background-color: #e0f7fa;}
th {text-align: center;}
select.form-select {text-align: center;}

/* Sticky header row */
thead th {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  z-index: 3;
}

/* Basic dropdown item styling */
.choices__list--dropdown .choices__item {
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  padding: 8px 12px;
}

/* Tooltip on hover */
.choices__list--dropdown .choices__item[title]:hover::after {
  content: attr(title);
  position: absolute;
  left: 100%;
  top: 0;
  margin-left: 8px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: #333;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 9999;
}
"))
# Output everything
cat(as.character(tagList(css, choices_assets, tbl, js_lookup)))

```

```{r image-row}
          val <- dt[spec==s & model==default_model, value]

          # If this is the image row, render an <img>; else plain text

              `data-model` = default_model,
              HTML(cell_html)
            )

            tags$td(
              `data-spec`  = s,
              `data-col`   = c,
              `data-model` = default_model,
              val
            )
          }
        })
      )
    })

)

# --- JS: swap columns (image-safe) ---
js_lookup <- tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
var specsData = %s;

function imageHTML(url){
  if(!url) return '';
  return (
    '<a href=\"' + url + '\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">' +
      '<img src=\"' + url + '\" alt=\"Bike photo\" ' +
      'style=\"height:120px; max-width:180px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px; display:block; margin:auto;\" />' +
    '</a>'
  );
}

function swapColumn(selectElem, colIndex) {
  var model = selectElem.value;
  var table = selectElem.closest('table');
  var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');

  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var specCell = row.querySelector('td[data-spec]');
    if(!specCell) return;
    var spec = specCell.getAttribute('data-spec');

    var item = specsData.find(function(d){ return d.spec===spec && d.model===model; });
    var cell = row.querySelector('td[data-col=\"' + colIndex + '\"]');
    if(!cell) return;

    if(item){
      var v = (item.value === null || item.value === 'NA') ? '' : item.value;
      if (spec === 'image') {
        cell.innerHTML = imageHTML(v);
      } else {
        cell.textContent = v;
      }
      cell.setAttribute('data-model', model);
    } else {
      if (spec === 'image') {
        cell.innerHTML = '';
      } else {
        cell.textContent = '';
      }
    }
  });
}
", json_data)))
```

```{r image-model-frame-size-rows}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: true
#| results: asis

# visible comparison columns
ncols <- 4

# spec columns present in geobike
specs_cols <- c("kmeans_style", "material", "fork", "handlebar", "stack", "reach", "head_tube_angle", "seat_tube_angle","chainstay_length", "front_center", "bottom_bracket_drop", "trail", "trail_45", "udh", "tire_width_max_700c", "tire_width_max_650b", "fork_class", "axle_spacing", "stealth_dropper", "seatpost_diameter", "max_chainring_1x", "dropout", "internal_storage", "base_build_usd", "frameset_usd")


# ── WIDE TABLE (model, frame_size) ──────────────────────────────────────────
keep_cols <- c("model","frame_size","model_size","image_url", specs_cols)
stopifnot(all(keep_cols %in% names(geobike)))

specs_wide <- geobike[, .SD, .SDcols = keep_cols]

# Friendly names
setnames(
  specs_wide,
  old = c("kmeans_style", "fork_class"),
  new = c("style",        "suspension_correction")
)

# Rounding / currency
specs_wide[, front_center := round(front_center, 0)]
specs_wide[, trail := round(trail, 0)]
specs_wide[, trail_45 := round(trail_45, 0)]
specs_wide[, frameset_usd := ifelse(is.na(frameset_usd), frameset_usd, paste0("$", frameset_usd))]
specs_wide[, base_build_usd := ifelse(is.na(base_build_usd), base_build_usd, paste0("$", base_build_usd))]

# reflect renamed columns
specs_cols[specs_cols == "kmeans_style"]   <- "style"
specs_cols[specs_cols == "fork_class"]     <- "suspension_correction"

# ── LONG TABLE (id: model + frame_size) ─────────────────────────────────────
dt <- melt(
  specs_wide,
  id.vars       = c("model","frame_size"),
  measure.vars  = specs_cols,
  variable.name = "spec",
  value.name    = "value"
)

# Pretty labels
dt[, spec_pretty := str_replace_all(spec, "_", " ")]
dt[, spec_pretty := str_to_title(spec_pretty)]
dt[, spec_pretty := str_replace(spec_pretty, "Udh", "UDH")]
dt[, spec_pretty := str_replace(spec_pretty, "Usd", "USD")]

# Sizes per model (for the size dropdown row)
sizes_by_model <- unique(specs_wide[, .(model, frame_size)])[order(model, frame_size)]

# IMAGE pseudo-spec (per model+size, using your image_url)
img_dt <- unique(specs_wide[, .(model, frame_size, spec="image", value=image_url)])
dt <- rbind(img_dt, dt, fill = TRUE)
dt[spec == "image", spec_pretty := "Image"]

# SIZE pseudo-spec row (UI only; values filled by JS)
size_row <- unique(specs_wide[, .(model, frame_size)])
size_row[, `:=`(spec = "size", value = NA_character_)]
dt <- rbindlist(list(size_row, dt), fill = TRUE)
dt[spec == "size", spec_pretty := "Size"]

# Models & defaults
models <- unique(specs_wide$model)
default_models <- models[seq_len(min(ncols, length(models)))]

choose_default_size <- function(m) {
  sz <- sizes_by_model[model == m, frame_size]
  if (!length(sz)) return(NA_character_)
  # prefer "M" if present, else first available
  if ("M" %in% sz) "M" else sz[1]
}
default_sizes <- vapply(default_models, choose_default_size, character(1))

# JSON payloads for JS
json_specs    <- toJSON(dt, dataframe="rows", auto_unbox=TRUE, na="null")
json_sizes    <- toJSON(sizes_by_model, dataframe="rows", auto_unbox=TRUE)
json_defaults <- toJSON(
  data.frame(col = seq_along(default_models), model = default_models, size = default_sizes),
  dataframe="rows", auto_unbox=TRUE
)

# ── HEADER (model selects) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
header_model_select <- function(i) {
  opts <- lapply(models, function(m) {
    if (i <= length(default_models) && identical(m, default_models[i])) {
      tags$option(value = m, selected = "selected", m)
    } else {
      tags$option(value = m, m)
    }
  })
  tags$select(
    class = "form-select form-select-sm searchable model-select",
    style = "width:220px; margin:auto;",
    onchange = sprintf("onModelChange(this, %d)", i),
    `data-col-index` = i,
    opts
  )
}

# ── TABLE HTML ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ordered_specs <- c("image","size", setdiff(unique(dt$spec), c("image","size")))

tbl <- tags$table(
  class = "table table-striped table-hover align-middle",
  style = "width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;",
  tags$thead(
    tags$tr(
      tags$th("Spec", style="position: sticky; top: 0; background:#f8f9fa; z-index: 2;"),
      lapply(seq_len(ncols), function(i) {
        tags$th(header_model_select(i), style="position: sticky; top: 0; background:#f8f9fa; z-index: 2;")
      })
    )
  ),
  tags$tbody(
    lapply(ordered_specs, function(s) {
      pretty_name <- unique(na.omit(dt[spec==s, spec_pretty]))[1]
      if (is.na(pretty_name)) pretty_name <- str_to_title(gsub("_"," ", s))
      tags$tr(
        tags$td(pretty_name, `data-spec` = s),
        lapply(seq_len(ncols), function(c) {
          default_model <- if (c <= length(default_models)) default_models[c] else models[1]
          default_size  <- if (c <= length(default_sizes)) default_sizes[c] else choose_default_size(default_model)

          if (s == "image") {
            url <- dt[spec=="image" & model==default_model & frame_size==default_size, value][1]
            if (length(url) == 0 || is.na(url) || identical(url,"NA")) url <- ""
            cell_html <- if (nzchar(url)) sprintf(
              '<a href="%1$s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
                 <img src="%1$s" alt="Bike photo"
                      style="height:120px; max-width:180px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px; display:block; margin:auto;" />
               </a>', url) else ""
            tags$td(
              `data-spec`  = s,
              `data-col`   = c,
              `data-model` = default_model,
              `data-size`  = default_size,
              HTML(cell_html)
            )
          } else if (s == "size") {
            sizes <- sizes_by_model[model == default_model, frame_size]
            opts <- if (length(sizes)) {
              lapply(sizes, function(sz) {
                if (!is.na(default_size) && identical(sz, default_size)) {
                  tags$option(value = sz, selected = "selected", sz)
                } else {
                  tags$option(value = sz, sz)
                }
              })
            } else list()
            tags$td(
              `data-spec`  = s, `data-col` = c, `data-model` = default_model, `data-size` = default_size,
              tags$select(
                class = "form-select form-select-sm size-select",
                style = "width:140px; margin:auto;",
                `data-col-index` = c,
                onchange = sprintf("onSizeChange(this, %d)", c),
                opts
              )
            )
          } else {
            val <- dt[spec==s & model==default_model & frame_size==default_size, value][1]
            if (length(val) == 0 || is.na(val) || identical(val,"NA")) val <- ""
            tags$td(
              `data-spec`  = s,
              `data-col`   = c,
              `data-model` = default_model,
              `data-size`  = default_size,
              val
            )
          }
        })
      )
    })
  )
)

# ── JS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
js_logic <- tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
var specsData   = %s;   // rows: {model, frame_size, spec, spec_pretty, value}
var sizesByModel = %s;  // rows: {model, frame_size}
var defaults    = %s;   // rows: {col, model, size}

// Build sizes map
var sizesMap = {};
sizesByModel.forEach(function(r){
  if(!sizesMap[r.model]) sizesMap[r.model] = [];
  if(r.frame_size && sizesMap[r.model].indexOf(r.frame_size) === -1) sizesMap[r.model].push(r.frame_size);
});

// Helpers
function imageHTML(url){
  if(!url) return '';
  return (
    '<a href=\"' + url + '\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">' +
      '<img src=\"' + url + '\" alt=\"Bike photo\" ' +
      'style=\"height:120px; max-width:180px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px; display:block; margin:auto;\" />' +
    '</a>'
  );
}

function findSpecValue(spec, model, size){
  var item = specsData.find(function(d){
    return d.spec === spec && d.model === model && d.frame_size === size;
  });
  return item ? (item.value == null || item.value === 'NA' ? '' : item.value) : '';
}

function refreshColumn(colIndex, model, size){
  var table = document.querySelector('table');
  var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');

  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var specCell = row.querySelector('td[data-spec]');
    if(!specCell) return;
    var spec = specCell.getAttribute('data-spec');
    var cell = row.querySelector('td[data-col=\"' + colIndex + '\"]');
    if(!cell) return;

    if (spec === 'image') {
      var url = findSpecValue('image', model, size);
      cell.innerHTML = imageHTML(url);
    } else if (spec === 'size') {
      // rebuild size options filtered to model
      var sizes = sizesMap[model] || [];
      var sel = cell.querySelector('select.size-select');
      if (sel){
        sel.innerHTML = '';
        sizes.forEach(function(sz){
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = sz;
          opt.textContent = sz;
          if (sz === size) opt.selected = true;
          sel.appendChild(opt);
        });
      }
    } else {
      var v = findSpecValue(spec, model, size);
      cell.textContent = v;
    }
    cell.setAttribute('data-model', model);
    cell.setAttribute('data-size', size);
  });
}

function onModelChange(selectElem, colIndex){
  var model = selectElem.value;
  var sizes = sizesMap[model] || [];
  var size = sizes.indexOf('M') >= 0 ? 'M' : (sizes[0] || '');
  refreshColumn(colIndex, model, size);
}

function onSizeChange(selectElem, colIndex){
  var size = selectElem.value;
  var anyCell = document.querySelector('td[data-col=\"' + colIndex + '\"]');
  var model = anyCell ? anyCell.getAttribute('data-model') : '';
  refreshColumn(colIndex, model, size);
}

// Init header selects with Choices.js and apply defaults
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var modelSelects = document.querySelectorAll('select.searchable.model-select');

  modelSelects.forEach(function(sel) {
    var colIndex = parseInt(sel.getAttribute('data-col-index'), 10);
    var choicesInstance = new Choices(sel, {
      searchEnabled: true,
      shouldSort: true,
      itemSelectText: '',
      placeholderValue: 'Select model...'
    });
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){
      onModelChange(sel, colIndex);
    });
  });

  // Apply initial defaults once
  defaults.forEach(function(d){
    refreshColumn(d.col, d.model, d.size);
  });
});
", json_specs, json_sizes, json_defaults)))

# ── CHOICES.JS ASSETS + CSS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
assets <- tagList(
  tags$head(
    tags$link(rel="stylesheet", href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/choices.js/public/assets/styles/choices.min.css"),
    tags$script(src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/choices.js/public/assets/scripts/choices.min.js")
  )
)

css <- tags$style(HTML("
.table-striped tbody tr:nth-of-type(odd) {background-color: #f9f9f9;}
.table-hover tbody tr:hover {background-color: #e0f7fa;}
th {text-align: center;}
select.form-select {text-align: center;}
thead th { position: sticky; top: 0; background: #f8f9fa; z-index: 3; }
td[data-spec='image'] { text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; background: #fafafa; }
td[data-spec='size']  { text-align: center; background: #fcfcfc; }
"))

# ── RENDER (preserve from Pandoc) ───────────────────────────────────────────
out <- tagList(css, assets, tbl, js_logic)
cat(as.character(htmltools::htmlPreserve(out)))
```

```{r validate-images}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
validate_images <- function(dt_img) {
  dt_img[, status := fifelse(is.na(value), "NA",
                      fifelse(trimws(value) == "", "empty",
                      fifelse(!grepl("^https?://", value), "non-http", "ok")))]
  dt_img[, .N, by = status][order(match(status, c("ok","non-http","empty","NA")))]
}
validate_images(img_dt)
```
